meta.description: Shigar da girke-girke ku ga UMF ɗinsa, rabon silica da alumina da daidaiton flux. Kyauta kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe, don girke-girke, kayan aiki da bayanan gasa.
meta.guides: Jagorori cikin sauƙaƙan harshe don sababbin maginan tukwane: mene ne glaze, yadda ake haɗa shi cikin aminci, kare iyalinku, da gasa a kiln mai sauƙi.
meta.glazingBasics: Abin da ake yin glaze da shi, yadda kiln ke mayar da shi gilashi, da ma'anar cone, frit, UMF da lahanin glaze. Jagora don sababbin maginan tukwane.
meta.makingAGlaze: Yadda ake saya, ajiye, auna da haɗa glaze, daidaita kaurinsa, gwada shi a kan yumɓunku da riƙe bayanai don ku sake yin sa.
meta.safeMixing: Yadda za ku hana ƙurar glaze shiga huhunku da hayaƙin kiln shiga gidanku: halaye masu aminci, respirator, tsaftacewa, iska da kaya masu haɗari.
meta.homeSafety: Abin da za a yi idan yaro ko dabba ya haɗiye kayan glaze, da yadda za a kiyaye kaya, ƙura, kiln da tukwanen hannu lafiya kusa da iyalinku.
meta.firing: Yadda ake gasa a kiln na lantarki: zaɓi, sanya da karanta cone, da bin tsare-tsaren gasa na bisque da glaze, tare da jadawalin cone.
meta.learnWithJohnBritt: Abokin kwas ɗin glaze na kyauta na John Britt a intanet: bidiyoyinsa naúra bayan naúra, tare da jagororin Glazecalc da atisaye a cikin lissafin.
meta.teachingGlazeCalculation: Zaman karatu 6 don koyar da UMF (unity molecular formula, tsarin Seger): kayan aiki da tayil na triaxial, mole, daga tsarin glaze zuwa formula da komawa, da lahanin glaze, tare da misalai da aka warware da takardun aiki don bugawa.
meta.advice: Shawarwari masu amfani kan haɗawa, shafa glaze da gasa, daga Glazecalc, da naku shawarwarin. Kyauta ga maginan tukwane.
meta.about: Glazecalc lissafi ne da littafin sinadaran glaze, kyauta kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe. Ga yadda yake lissafin UMF da yadda aka gina shi.
meta.privacy: Yadda Glazecalc ke sarrafa bayananku: babu talla, babu bincike, babu bin diddigi, ba a sayar da komai. Abin da ake ajiyewa, dalili, da haƙƙoƙinku.
meta.terms: Sharuɗɗan amfani da Glazecalc: kyauta don glaze da aikinku, adalci ga sabar da kowa ke amfani da ita, kuma ana bayar da shi yadda yake.
meta.assistants: Yi amfani da Glazecalc daga Claude, Copilot, Cursor ko Gemini ta MCP: sinadaran glaze, duba iyaka, maye gurbi, jagorori, da girke-girkenku.
meta.signup: Buɗe asusun Glazecalc kyauta don ajiye girke-girken glaze, kayan aiki, rubuce-rubuce da bayanan gasa. Babu talla, kuma ba a taɓa sayar da bayananku.
meta.cones: Cone na Orton da SK daga 022 zuwa sama, da zafinsu a °C da °F, saurin zafi da kowane jadawali yake don shi da inda adadin suka fito.
meta.materials: Kayan da ke cikin laburaren Glazecalc, daga feldspar da yumɓu zuwa frit da tushen boron, kowanne da sinadaran oxide, UMF da haɗarinsa.
meta.materialInfo: {name}: sinadaran oxide, UMF, LOI da haɗari a cikin laburaren Glazecalc.
meta.materialInfoLong: {name} a cikin laburaren kayan glaze na Glazecalc: sinadaran oxide ɗinsa, gudummawarsa ga UMF, LOI da haɗari.
meta.famousGlazes: Shahararrun glaze daga ko'ina a duniya: tsarin gargajiya ko nazarin tarihi na kowane glaze, UMF ɗinsa, da sigar da aka yi da kayan da ake sayarwa inda kuke.
meta.famousGlaze: Glaze ɗin {name} ({native}): tsarinsa na gargajiya ko nazarin tarihi, gasa, UMF da majiyoyi, da sigar da aka yi da kayan da ake sayarwa inda kuke.
meta.imageAlt: Tambarin Glazecalc da takensa, sinadaran glaze kyauta don maginan tukwane, kusa da hoton cone da aka gasa.

notice.label: Game da wannan fassara
notice.text: AI ce ta fassara wannan shafi daga Turanci. Glazecalc buɗaɗɗen tushe ne: idan wani abu bai yi daidai ba, don Allah ku ba da shawarar gyara a GitHub.
notice.brief: AI ce ta fassara daga Turanci.
notice.plain: AI ce ta fassara wannan shafi daga Turanci, kuma ba ta iya wannan harshe sosai kamar yawancin harsuna. Shafin Turanci zai iya fi sauƙin karantawa. Glazecalc buɗaɗɗen tushe ne: idan wani abu bai yi daidai ba, don Allah ku ba da shawarar gyara a GitHub.
notice.plainBrief: AI ce ta fassara; Turancin zai iya fi kyau.

settingsExpiry.text: Ba ku yi amfani da Glazecalc a wannan burauza ba kusan shekara ɗaya. Ana riƙe saitunanku a nan, kamar jigo da harshe, muddin kuna amfani da ita. Kuna iya share su yanzu idan kuna so. Saitunan da aka ajiye a asusunku ba abin ya shafa ba.
